app.name: Button Break Wii
app.long_description: A port of Button Break, the Homebrew app for Wii U.. but on the Wii! v0.1 - First release 0.2 - Added Nunchuk buttons.. more presses! v0.3 - Added lines in between presses v0.4 - Added the right Punctuation and changed Minus and Plus to Select and Start v0.5 - Made 2 different apps - Wii Remote and Nunchuk because there was no way to just only use the wii remote in v0.4. v0.6 - Made the 2 apps into one. v0.7 - Added where you can actually exit the program instead of turning the wii completely off.
